dimensions.assessment: Affects all motorcoach manufacturers producing new buses for sale in the United States and commercial bus operators nationwide.
dimensions.evidence: require that all new covered motorcoaches manufactured for sale in the United States have a minimally obstructed forward-facing view

dimensions.assessment: Requires manufacturers and operators to alter design or incorporate approved camera/technological means, representing a moderate engineering and compliance requirement.
dimensions.evidence: utilizes a camera or other technological means... to allow for a minimally obstructed forward-facing view

dimensions.assessment: Direct federal spending figures are not stated, though the rulemaking entails standard administrative and regulatory costs for NHTSA.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary, acting through the Administrator of the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration, shall prescribe motor vehicle safety standards

dimensions.assessment: Amends federal motor vehicle safety statutes (title 49, United States Code) to mandate a new specific safety standard for motorcoaches.
dimensions.evidence: To amend subchapter II of chapter 301 of title 49, United States Code, to require that all new covered motorcoaches have a minimally obstructed forward-facing view

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent regulatory requirement for all newly manufactured covered motorcoaches starting within one year of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of the enactment of this section, the Secretary... shall prescribe motor vehicle safety standards

missing_information: Specific estimates of compliance costs for manufacturers are not provided.
Exact definitions of the threshold dimensions for what constitutes a 'minimally obstructed' view beyond what is written are delegated entirely to future administrative rulemaking.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration to establish safety standards ensuring all new covered motorcoaches have a minimally obstructed forward-facing view from the driver's seat. This affects motorcoach manufacturers, commercial bus operators, and transit safety nationwide.
